title: High-energy 3D CGI animated comedy in the style of a Pixar-quality blockbuster…
content:
High-energy 3D CGI animated comedy in the style of a Pixar-quality blockbuster short — exaggerated squash-and-stretch physics, vibrant colors, dynamic camera (fast whip pans, Dutch tilts, speed-ramp dolly-ins). Rain-slicked Gotham-like rooftop at night, then dawn.

MULTI-SHOT SEQUENCE, ~30 seconds:

Shot 1 (0-7s): Night, rain, dramatic thunder. The red bug vigilante perches broodily on a stone gargoyle, cape-wings spread, lightning flashing. He rasps in his deepest voice: "I am the night. I am vengeance." A pigeon lands on his antenna. He instantly breaks character, voice going normal and fast: "Okay who let Gary in, we talked about this—" He swats at it, slips comically, catches the gargoyle.

Shot 2 (7-14s): The huge blue tank hero walks calmly into frame carrying a trash-can lid like a shield. Without hurry he hurls it — RICOCHET, RICOCHET, RICOCHET off three chimneys and it lands perfectly on the pigeon's head like a helmet. Blue says warmly: "On your left." Bug, rubbing his head: "We need to talk about your warning system."

Shot 3 (14-23s): Dawn breaks golden. They stand back to back on the rooftop edge as alarm bells ring below — a giant robotic cat-shaped blimp rises over the city (villain tease). Bug spreads his wings heroically, trying to sound epic again: "I can buzz all day." Blue pats his shoulder, dead serious: "So that's it? We're some kind of Bug League?" Bug gasps with delight: "THAT'S the name?! I've been workshopping for WEEKS—"

Shot 4 (23-30s): Both leap off the roof in dramatic slow-motion toward camera, wings buzzing, cape flapping, city lights behind — then smash cut to them crashing through a laundry line and emerging wearing pajama pants and a bra as capes. Freeze frame mid-run. Title card slams in: "BUG LEAGUE".

Audio: moody dark-knight style score that keeps getting interrupted by comedic stings, thunder, wing-buzz SFX, trash-lid ricochet clanks, clear characterful voices — deep gravelly voice for the bug vigilante that cracks into rapid quips, slow warm baritone for the blue tank. Lips sync only to scripted lines.

es.content:
Comedia animada CGI 3D de alta energía al estilo de un cortometraje taquillero de calidad Pixar — física exagerada de squash and stretch, colores vibrantes, cámara dinámica (rápidos whip pans, Dutch tilts, speed-ramp dolly-ins). Azotea empapada por la lluvia, tipo Gotham, de noche; luego, amanecer.

SECUENCIA DE MULTI-SHOT, ~30 segundos:

Shot 1 (0-7s): Noche, lluvia, truenos dramáticos. El vigilante insecto rojo se posa con aire sombrío sobre una gárgola de piedra, con las alas-capa extendidas y relámpagos iluminándolo. Gruñe con su voz más grave: "I am the night. I am vengeance." Una paloma aterriza sobre su antena. De inmediato rompe el personaje, con la voz normal y rápida: "Okay who let Gary in, we talked about this—" Le da un manotazo, resbala de forma cómica y se agarra a la gárgola.

Shot 2 (7-14s): El enorme héroe tanque azul entra caminando con calma en cuadro, llevando la tapa de un cubo de basura como si fuera un escudo. Sin prisa, la lanza — RICOCHET, RICOCHET, RICOCHET — contra tres chimeneas y aterriza perfectamente sobre la cabeza de la paloma como un casco. Blue dice con calidez: "On your left." Bug, frotándose la cabeza: "We need to talk about your warning system."

Shot 3 (14-23s): Amanece con un resplandor dorado. Se colocan espalda con espalda en el borde de la azotea mientras suenan campanas de alarma abajo — un gigantesco dirigible robótico con forma de gato se eleva sobre la ciudad (teaser del villano). Bug despliega heroicamente sus alas, intentando sonar épico otra vez: "I can buzz all day." Blue le da una palmada en el hombro, totalmente serio: "So that's it? We're some kind of Bug League?" Bug jadea de emoción: "THAT'S the name?! I've been workshopping for WEEKS—"

Shot 4 (23-30s): Ambos saltan desde el techo en cámara lenta y de forma dramática hacia la cámara, con las alas zumbando, la capa ondeando y las luces de la ciudad detrás — luego corte brusco a ellos estrellándose contra un tendedero y apareciendo con pantalones de pijama y un sujetador como capas. Freeze frame en plena carrera. La tarjeta de título irrumpe con fuerza: "BUG LEAGUE".

Audio: banda sonora sombría al estilo dark knight que se ve interrumpida constantemente por golpes cómicos, truenos, SFX de zumbido de alas, choques metálicos de rebote de la tapa de basura, voces claras y con personalidad — voz grave y rasposa para el vigilante insecto que se quiebra en réplicas veloces, barítono lento y cálido para el tanque azul. Lip sync solo con las líneas guionizadas.

fr.content:
Comédie animée 3D CGI à haute énergie, dans le style d’un court-métrage blockbuster de qualité Pixar — physique exagérée en squash-and-stretch, couleurs vibrantes, caméra dynamique (whip pans rapides, Dutch tilts, speed-ramp dolly-ins). Toit de type Gotham, détrempé par la pluie, de nuit, puis à l’aube.

SÉQUENCE MULTI-SHOT, ~30 secondes :

Shot 1 (0-7s): Nuit, pluie, tonnerre dramatique. Le justicier insecte rouge est perché d’un air sombre sur une gargouille en pierre, ailes-cape déployées, éclairs au loin. Il gronde de sa voix la plus grave : "I am the night. I am vengeance." Un pigeon se pose sur son antenne. Il sort instantanément de son personnage, sa voix redevenant normale et rapide : "Okay who let Gary in, we talked about this—" Il lui donne un coup, glisse de façon comique, puis se rattrape à la gargouille.

Shot 2 (7-14s): Le gigantesque héros tank bleu entre calmement dans le cadre en portant un couvercle de poubelle comme un bouclier. Sans se presser, il le lance — RICOCHET, RICOCHET, RICOCHET sur trois cheminées, puis il atterrit parfaitement sur la tête du pigeon comme un casque. Blue dit chaleureusement : "On your left." Bug, se frottant la tête : "We need to talk about your warning system."

Shot 3 (14-23s): L’aube se lève, dorée. Ils se tiennent dos à dos au bord du toit tandis que des sirènes retentissent en contrebas — un gigantesque dirigeable robotique en forme de chat s’élève au-dessus de la ville (tease du méchant). Bug déploie ses ailes avec héroïsme, essayant de reprendre un ton épique : "I can buzz all day." Blue lui tapote l’épaule, très sérieux : "So that's it? We're some kind of Bug League?" Bug halète de joie : "THAT'S the name?! I've been workshopping for WEEKS—"

Shot 4 (23-30s): Tous deux sautent du toit au ralenti, face caméra, ailes bourdonnantes, cape flottant au vent, lumières de la ville derrière eux — puis cut brutal sur eux traversant un fil à linge et réapparaissant en portant un pantalon de pyjama et un soutien-gorge en guise de capes. Freeze frame en pleine course. Carton-titre qui claque : "BUG LEAGUE".

Audio: musique sombre et mélancolique à la Dark Knight, sans cesse interrompue par des accents comiques, tonnerre, SFX de bourdonnement d’ailes, cliquetis de ricochet du couvercle de poubelle, voix de personnages bien marquées — voix grave et rocailleuse pour le justicier insecte, qui se brise en répliques rapides, baryton lent et chaleureux pour le tank bleu. Synchronisation labiale uniquement sur les répliques écrites.

ja.content:
高エネルギーな3D CGIアニメコメディ。ピクサー級の大作短編のようなスタイルで、誇張されたスクワッシュ＆ストレッチの物理表現、鮮やかな色彩、ダイナミックなカメラワーク（高速のホイップパン、ダッチアングル、スピードランプ付きのドリーイン）。雨に濡れたゴッサム風の屋上、夜から夜明けへ。

マルチショット構成、約30秒：

ショット1（0〜7秒）：夜、雨、劇的な雷鳴。赤い虫の自警団ヒーローが石造りのガーゴイルの上に物憂げに腰掛け、ケープの翼を広げ、稲妻が閃く。彼は最も低い声でしわがれながら言う。「I am the night. I am vengeance.」そこへハトが彼の触角に着地する。彼は即座にキャラを崩し、普通の早口で言う。「Okay who let Gary in, we talked about this—」ハトを払いのけようとしてコミカルに足を滑らせ、ガーゴイルにしがみつく。

ショット2（7〜14秒）：巨大な青いタンク系ヒーローが、ゴミ箱のフタを盾のように持って、落ち着いてフレームインする。焦らずそれを投げると、3本の煙突でRICOCHET、RICOCHET、RICOCHETと跳ね返り、ハトの頭にヘルメットのように完璧に収まる。ブルーは温かく言う。「On your left.」虫ヒーローは頭をさすりながら言う。「We need to talk about your warning system.」

ショット3（14〜23秒）：夜明けが金色に染まる。2人は屋上の縁で背中合わせに立ち、下では警報ベルが鳴り響く。巨大なロボット猫型の飛行船が街の上に姿を現す（ヴィランの予告）。虫ヒーローは英雄的に翼を広げ、再び壮大に聞こえようとして言う。「I can buzz all day.」ブルーは彼の肩を叩き、真顔で言う。「So that's it? We're some kind of Bug League?」虫ヒーローは喜びに息をのむ。「THAT'S the name?! I've been workshopping for WEEKS—」

ショット4（23〜30秒）：2人はドラマチックなスローモーションでカメラに向かって屋上から飛び降り、翼が羽音を立て、ケープがはためき、背後に街の灯りが広がる――そして突然のスマッシュカットで、洗濯物のロープに突っ込み、パジャマパンツとブラをケープ代わりに身につけた姿で現れる。走りながらフリーズフレーム。タイトルカードが勢いよく表示される：「BUG LEAGUE」。

音声：ムーディーなダークナイト風スコアが、コメディの短い音で何度も中断される。雷鳴、翼の羽音のSFX、ゴミ箱のフタが跳ね返る金属音、個性のある明瞭なキャラクターボイス――虫の自警団ヒーローは低くしゃがれた声で、そこから高速の軽口へとひび割れるように変化し、青いタンクはゆっくり温かいバリトン。リップシンクは台本のセリフにのみ合わせる。

--- スレッド継続 ---

ko.content:
픽사급 블록버스터 단편 같은 스타일의 하이 에너지 3D CGI 애니메이션 코미디 — 과장된 스쿼시 앤 스트레치 물리, 생생한 색감, 역동적인 카메라(빠른 휩 팬, 더치 틸트, 스피드 램프 돌리 인). 밤에는 비에 젖은 고담풍 옥상, 이어서 새벽.

멀티샷 시퀀스, 약 30초:

샷 1 (0-7초): 밤, 비, 극적인 천둥. 붉은 벌레 자경단원이 돌로 된 가고일 위에 우울하게 웅크리고 앉아 있고, 망토 날개를 펼친 채 번개가 번쩍인다. 그는 가장 낮고 거친 목소리로 쉰 듯 말한다: "I am the night. I am vengeance." 비둘기 한 마리가 그의 더듬이에 내려앉는다. 그는 즉시 캐릭터를 깨고, 평소의 빠른 목소리로 말한다: "Okay who let Gary in, we talked about this—" 그는 비둘기를 쳐내려다 코믹하게 미끄러지고, 가고일을 붙잡는다.

샷 2 (7-14초): 거대한 파란 탱크 히어로가 쓰레기통 뚜껑을 방패처럼 들고 차분하게 프레임 안으로 걸어 들어온다. 서두르지 않고 그것을 던지자 — RICOCHET, RICOCHET, RICOCHET — 세 개의 굴뚝에 튕겨 나가 비둘기 머리에 헬멧처럼 완벽하게 착지한다. 블루가 따뜻하게 말한다: "On your left." 벌레 히어로가 머리를 문지르며 말한다: "We need to talk about your warning system."

샷 3 (14-23초): 새벽이 황금빛으로 밝아온다. 아래에서는 경보 종이 울리고, 그들은 옥상 가장자리에 등을 맞댄 채 선다 — 거대한 로봇 고양이 모양의 비행선이 도시 위로 떠오른다(빌런 예고). 벌레 히어로가 영웅적으로 날개를 펼치며 다시 장엄하게 들리려 애쓴다: "I can buzz all day." 블루가 그의 어깨를 두드리며, 지극히 진지한 표정으로 말한다: "So that's it? We're some kind of Bug League?" 벌레 히어로가 기쁨에 숨을 들이쉰다: "THAT'S the name?! I've been workshopping for WEEKS—"

pt.content:
Comédia animada em CGI 3D de alta energia, no estilo de um curta blockbuster com qualidade Pixar — física exagerada de squash-and-stretch, cores vibrantes, câmera dinâmica (whip pans rápidos, Dutch tilts, dolly-ins com speed ramp). Telhado encharcado de chuva, em uma Gotham-like, à noite, depois ao amanhecer.

SEQUÊNCIA MULTI-SHOT, ~30 segundos:

Shot 1 (0-7s): Noite, chuva, trovões dramáticos. O vigilante inseto vermelho está empoleirado de forma soturna sobre uma gárgula de pedra, com as asas-capa abertas, relâmpagos cortando o céu. Ele rosna com sua voz mais grave: "I am the night. I am vengeance." Um pombo pousa em sua antena. Ele imediatamente sai do personagem, com a voz normal e rápida: "Okay who let Gary in, we talked about this—" Ele tenta espantá-lo, escorrega de forma cômica, e se agarra à gárgula.

Shot 2 (7-14s): O enorme herói tanque azul entra calmamente em quadro carregando uma tampa de lixeira como escudo. Sem pressa, ele a arremessa — RICOCHET, RICOCHET, RICOCHET em três chaminés e ela aterrissa perfeitamente na cabeça do pombo, como um capacete. Blue diz com carinho: "On your left." Bug, esfregando a cabeça: "We need to talk about your warning system."

Shot 3 (14-23s): O amanhecer surge dourado. Eles ficam de costas um para o outro na beira do telhado enquanto sinos de alarme soam lá embaixo — um enorme dirigível robótico em forma de gato sobe sobre a cidade (teaser do vilão). Bug abre as asas heroicamente, tentando soar épico de novo: "I can buzz all day." Blue bate no ombro dele, com seriedade total: "So that's it? We're some kind of Bug League?" Bug suspira, encantado: "THAT'S the name?! I've been workshopping for WEEKS—"

Shot 4 (23-30s): Os dois saltam do telhado em câmera lenta dramática em direção à câmera, asas zumbindo, capa esvoaçando, luzes da cidade ao fundo — então corte brusco para eles atravessando um varal de roupas e surgindo usando calças de pijama e um sutiã como capas. Freeze frame no meio da corrida. Cartela de título entra com impacto: "BUG LEAGUE".

Áudio: trilha sombria no estilo dark knight que continua sendo interrompida por stings cômicos, trovões, SFX de zumbido das asas, cliques metálicos do ricochete da tampa de lixeira, vozes claras e marcantes — voz grave e rouca para o vigilante inseto, que se quebra em tiradas rápidas, barítono lento e caloroso para o tanque azul. Sincronia labial apenas nas falas roteirizadas.

zh.content:
高能 3D CGI 动画喜剧，风格类似皮克斯级大片短片——夸张的挤压与拉伸物理效果、鲜艳的色彩、动态镜头（快速甩镜、荷兰式倾斜、变速推进式推轨镜头）。雨水打湿的哥谭风格屋顶，夜晚，随后黎明。

多镜头序列，约 30 秒：

镜头 1（0-7 秒）：夜晚、下雨、雷声轰鸣。红色昆虫义警阴郁地蹲伏在石制石像鬼上，披风般的翅膀展开，闪电划过。他用最低沉的声音沙哑地说：“I am the night. I am vengeance.” 一只鸽子落在他的触角上。他立刻破功，声音恢复正常且语速飞快：“Okay who let Gary in, we talked about this—” 他伸手去拍它，滑稽地打了个趔趄，抓住了石像鬼。

镜头 2（7-14 秒）：巨大的蓝色坦克英雄平静地走入画面，手里拿着一个垃圾桶盖当盾牌。他不慌不忙地把它扔出去——RICOCHET, RICOCHET, RICOCHET——它在三根烟囱之间弹射，最后像头盔一样稳稳落到鸽子头上。蓝色英雄温和地说：“On your left.” 昆虫英雄揉着头说：“We need to talk about your warning system.”

镜头 3（14-23 秒）：黎明泛起金色。两人背靠背站在屋顶边缘，楼下警铃大作——一艘巨大的机械猫形飞艇升上城市上空（反派预告）。昆虫英雄英雄式地展开翅膀，努力再次说得史诗感十足：“I can buzz all day.” 蓝色英雄拍了拍他的肩膀，神情严肃：“So that's it? We're some kind of Bug League?” 昆虫英雄惊喜地倒吸一口气：“THAT'S the name?! I've been workshopping for WEEKS—”

镜头 4（23-30 秒）：两人以戏剧化慢动作跃下屋顶冲向镜头，翅膀嗡鸣，披风飞扬，身后是城市灯火——随后猛切到他们撞穿一条晾衣绳，狼狈现身，身上穿着睡裤，胸前还挂着把胸罩当披风。中途定格。标题卡重重砸入画面：“BUG LEAGUE”。

音频：阴郁的黑暗骑士风格配乐不断被喜剧音效打断，伴随雷声、翅膀嗡鸣音效、垃圾桶盖弹射碰撞声，以及清晰鲜明的角色配音——昆虫义警是低沉沙哑的嗓音，但会突然切成快速吐槽；蓝色坦克则是缓慢、温暖的男中音。口型只需对齐脚本台词。
